title: Two girls and women we remember with love
intro: Today we remember two women from northern Italy, one of them a baby girl. Their names have not been published, and we respect that. We keep them in the light with gratitude.

women.name: A woman from Varese
tribute: A woman from Varese, in Lombardy. Her name and age have not been published, and we respect that.

women.name: A baby girl from Pozzolo Formigaro
tribute: A baby girl of four months from Pozzolo Formigaro, in the province of Alessandria, whose name has not been published.
She and her family are in our thoughts.
